HG24-ow1:
Troubleshooting

Nothing happens

Try starting a bit smaller?

Can you show me a single sensation in the body? Can you show me a single word? Can you show me whether to listen or rest today?

It feels fake

Do you know what it is that feels fake? The words? The image? What you expected? The role? Just because you don't have an inner voice/image doing this, it doesn't mean you are missing some grown-up ability or resisting doing the work. If you feel that something is asking you to do something that you do not want to do, then correct it. If you feel that a part might be protecting you from this, then talk to it.

“What are you protecting me from?” or “Are you afraid I will lie to myself again?” or “Are you afraid this will just be a performance?”

It could be an inner voice of a parent you are picking up that is enforcing a rule about how you should be to belong, if so don’t argue with it, find out what rule it is enforcing and then work on finding ordinary evidence that would make your new adult voice more believable.

If the fake feeling is telling you some grown-up ability isn’t there yet, stop trying to believe an inner voice. If you have enough observing ego, borrow whatever you need - warmth, boundary, direction etc - from someone who you can imagine is good enough, maybe a family member, a friend or a famous person. Try out something which rings true, a sentence, an action etc and see how it goes.
HG36-ew1:
Intensity then gets mistaken for meaning. Sometimes the inner child is finally speaking. Sometimes a Protector is showing fear, or shame, grief, anger, longing, and other buried material are asking for care. But an intense state can also be bodily overload, environmental chaos, sleep deprivation, or plain confusion. A frightening image isn’t automatically truth, a bad feeling isn’t automatically a lesson, and a “download” doesn’t deserve belief merely because it came with excellent lighting.

Before trying to interpret the state, ask a simpler question:
HG17-mw1:
Sober induction: 3–5 minutes

Practise reading this slowly into a recorder, or reading it aloud, or if you can learn it and use silent words. Choose to use one of the three anchors – sound, bodily contact or two hands - throughout and choose an opening phrase. Whenever the words below refer to ‘the anchor’ use the one you’ve chosen. Pause for a few moments at the end of each paragraph. Don’t read aloud the instructions for how to do the reading.

Let your eyes settle somewhere in the room, somewhere they can rest for a little while, and notice the difference between looking for something and letting what is already there come into view.

As you notice the surface beneath you, notice the feel of the contact, the pressure, whatever you can actually feel. And while you notice that, a sound may reach you, or a breath may draw your attention, without needing you to arrange either one.

There’s time to do this.

It might be that a thought about something that’s happened during the day is still with you, or perhaps there’s a thought about doing this properly. Whatever is there, can you find it in yourself to turn your attention back to the anchor, even if there is a thought there?
HG17-mw2:
and when you do come back, you may find one detail that holds your interest, something about the sound, or the contact, or that particular way of listening, and let attention stay with it long enough to become curious

Perhaps you can give yourself the time that you might give to someone dear to you who has begun to speak and hasn’t yet found the words. You can remain nearby, listening, without finishing their sentence for them

Let the phrase you chose come to mind, say it as an invitation, and notice how it is received

You can close your eyes, soften them or keep them open as you proceed. Let that be a choice you make. Listening may deepen while a sound from the room remains available in the background

Count slowly from 5 to 1, giving each number its own moment
HG17-mw3:
5, perhaps notice again what you have chosen to be your anchor for today, 4, let attention gather around what you find, 3, leave a little space after the words, 2, listen into that space, without preparing an answer, 1, stay here for a moment

Bring to mind, lightly, your chosen concern. Or simply, stay with the wish to contact. Let it be present without rehearsing its whole story.

What do you notice now?

Allow yourself some time to notice what is coming. It might be sensations, words, images, feelings, the urge to move in some way or nothing clear yet.

Allow yourself some time to notice this, with or without words.
HG18-mw1:
Come all the way back

Come out of the session by reversing the entry method; if you floated, come back down by the same method; land with your chosen weight. If you shrunk, come back to your normal size. If you meet your younger self or parts, make sure that you acknowledge that you are now whole, this is your body, and you are using your adult judgement. If you traveled, then come back the same way you left. Make sure that you are only bringing back what you had intended to bring back.

Say, “I am bringing back only what is useful now. All that is not needed at this time will remain safely stored away until such time as I am ready. I am now coming back to this place and to my body and to normal day to day living, and to one honest action. All instructions to go deeper or stay in this session are now over. I keep only the ordinary-life intention or future-practice cue I consciously chose, and neither one keeps today’s altered state running. I am myself, in my body, with my adult judgment fully available.”

Count yourself out: 1. Coming back into your body and your chosen weight. 2. Coming back to your normal breathing pattern. 3. Hearing the room, and naming where you are. 4. Moving your fingers and your toes and your shoulders and your eyes. 5. Opening your eyes, feeling present, normal and clear. Your session is now over.
HG18-mw2:
Say to yourself what day it is or what the date is, look to your left and to your right, look at something near and something far away, move about a bit before you stand up, stand up only when you’re steady, and make sure that you are actually oriented and alert (repeating the count isn’t proof that you’re all the way back). Take note of only what actually came up during your session and what you may or may not need to do as a result, and then just go about doing something normal.

In the event that a recording that you are listening to stops unexpectedly, simply say to yourself “the recording has stopped and the session is over” and then use the above method to come out by opening your eyes, saying where you are, saying what day it is, pushing down with your feet or your hands, moving about, looking around and then using the 5 step method. Don’t sit there waiting for the voice to come back and release you.

Note: If you are using a recording to go to sleep, then it is all right to let the recording put you to sleep or have you in a quiet resting state. However, if it’s a recording for waking practice, then it should not leave you in a role, with lowered judgement, impaired movement capabilities, blank, with an undefined reset word, or invited to stay altered indefinitely.
